children: Amerant Bancorp reported 2Q26 net income of $21.0 million and highlighted asset growth to $10.3 billion.
Total assets grew to $10.3B in 2Q26 from $9.9B in 1Q26, reflecting balance sheet expansion.
Total deposits increased to $8.4B (core deposits $6.4B), supporting liquidity and funding.
Net income attributable to the company rose to $21.0M in 2Q26 vs $17.9M in 1Q26; diluted EPS $0.53.
Credit quality improved: NPLs fell to $171.1M and classified loans to $273.1M after portfolio clean-up actions.
Outlook: management projects loans ~ $7.3B and deposits ~ $9.1B by 4Q26 and targets ~3.50% NIM and ~60% efficiency ratio.
